purpose: Teach: 版画/トランク/牡蠣/酒場/風呂敷/ヒーター/白髪/笹

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが版画の作品を作ったのよ
lines.en: Sho, I made a woodblock print. Would you like to see it?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Slight lift at the end, genuinely curious about his interest. Speaks to him at eye level, not down. The affection of a trusted older presence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママのトランクの中身が気になるよ
lines.en: Mei-san... I've been wondering what's inside Mum's trunk.
lines.style: Quiet, almost hesitant opening. Voice trails upward slightly on 'trunk' — the uncertainty of a child broaching something he's noticed. Genuine curiosity, not accusation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと牡蠣のお店に行きたいわね
lines.en: Sho, wouldn't you like to go to an oyster restaurant with your father?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, as if planting an idea. Warm and encouraging without pushing. Slight pause before 'father' — noticing something about that want.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんは酒場へよく行くんだって
lines.en: Mei-san... Dad goes to the tavern a lot, you know.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation delivered softly. Small child reporting what he's learned, testing whether it's important. No judgment in the voice, just noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが風呂敷でお弁当包んでくれたよ
lines.en: Sho, I wrapped your bento in a furoshiki cloth for you.
lines.style: Tender, almost intimate. The voice of someone who has quietly done something kind and is letting him know without fanfare. Slight warmth on the care implied.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんの家のヒーター古いんだって
lines.en: Mei-san... Grandpa's heater at home is really old, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. A child noticing something practical and worrying about it quietly. No drama — just stating what he's seen, perhaps a small note of concern underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの白髪、かっこいいわよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather's white hair looks so distinguished.
lines.style: Admiring, with genuine affection underneath. Voice lilts slightly on 'distinguished' — she's really seeing him and wants Sho to see it too. Sincere without being performative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、七夕で笹に願いを書いたよ
lines.en: Mei-san... for Tanabata, I wrote a wish on the bamboo leaves.
lines.style: Eager, proud, and trusting her with something small and precious. Voice brightens on the telling. The openness of a child sharing something he cares about with someone safe.
